description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Fujin
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Fuzan (0~2), removed after using Fuzan two times

description.name: Fuzan Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Fuzan level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Fujin]

description.name: Fuzan Level
description.text: Keeps track of Fuzan level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Fujin]
